entities.description: A young boy with light brown skin and tight, curly brown hair smiles broadly at the camera, wearing a blue and white plaid button-down shirt with a black lanyard around his neck. He is positioned in the foreground, with an adult's hand resting on his shoulder and a blurred classroom background visible behind him.

A heavily blurred, out-of-focus person with short brown hair is visible in the background, wearing a dark blue or black jacket over a lighter shirt, seated at a wooden table. The foreground is dominated by a sharp, close-up view of a textured, heather grey fabric, likely a sweater or coat, obscuring the person's face and body.

A smiling woman with short blonde hair and a young boy with curly brown hair stand side-by-side, with the woman's hand resting on the boy's shoulder. The woman wears a grey fleece jacket over a light blue button-down shirt and has a black DSLR camera hanging from a strap around her neck, while the boy wears a blue and white plaid flannel shirt with a black lanyard around his neck.
